compiled_state.description: ## Testing Mode RED ## Story 0263-62ba — Migrate 4 consumers to PRECONDITIONS, add compaction on epic-closure with ordering contract, and legacy-ticket graceful-degrade ## Objective Write failing tests that assert the behavior of the new compaction and snapshot-read functions that will be added to ticket-lib.sh. Tests must fail (RED) before implementation runs. ## Test File `tests/scripts/test-preconditions-compaction.sh` (new file — fuzzy-matchable: normalized source `ticketlibsh` is a substring of normalized test `testpreconditionscompactionsh`? No. Must add .test-index entry.) **Required .test-index entries:** - `plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh: tests/scripts/test-preconditions-compaction.sh [test_compact_preconditions_writes_snapshot]` - `plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh: tests/scripts/test-preconditions-compaction.sh [test_read_latest_handles_snapshot_format]` - `plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh: tests/scripts/test-preconditions-compaction.sh [test_read_latest_retry_once_on_transient_miss]` ## Test Approach (Given/When/Then) **test_compact_preconditions_writes_snapshot:** - Given: a ticket dir containing 3 PRECONDITIONS events (flat JSON files) with sequential timestamps - When: `_compact_preconditions <ticket_dir> <epic_id>` is called - Then: a single PRECONDITIONS-SNAPSHOT.json file exists; each original event file contains a `retired: true` marker in its filename (renamed or a marker file beside it) **test_read_latest_handles_snapshot_format:** - Given: a ticket dir where flat events have been compacted (PRECONDITIONS-SNAPSHOT.json present, original events retired) - When: `_read_latest_preconditions <ticket_dir>` is called - Then: returns the snapshot payload; exit 0 **test_read_latest_retry_once_on_transient_miss:** - Given: a ticket dir where PRECONDITIONS-SNAPSHOT.json is transiently missing at first stat (simulated via a wrapper that removes then re-creates the file mid-read) - When: `_read_latest_preconditions <ticket_dir>` is called - Then: retries once and returns the snapshot payload on second attempt; exit 0 ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] `tests/scripts/test-preconditions-compaction.sh` exists and is executable   Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-preconditions-compaction.sh - [ ] test_compact_preconditions_writes_snapshot fails RED (function not yet implemented)   Verify: source plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh 2>/dev/null; declare -f _compact_preconditions | grep -q "_compact_preconditions" && echo "FAIL: function exists already" || echo "RED confirmed" - [ ] test_read_latest_handles_snapshot_format fails RED   Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-preconditions-compaction.sh test_read_latest_handles_snapshot_format 2>&1 | grep -qiE "not found|error|FAIL" - [ ] test_read_latest_retry_once_on_transient_miss fails RED   Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-preconditions-compaction.sh test_read_latest_retry_once_on_transient_miss 2>&1 | grep -qiE "not found|error|FAIL" - [ ] .test-index updated with RED markers for all 3 tests   Verify: grep -c '\[test_compact_preconditions_writes_snapshot\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index - [ ] `bash tests/run-all.sh` exits without introducing new unrelated failures   Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5 ## Retry Budget MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model) On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages) On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
